title: About the Agreement on Peace and Security
intro1:
People are free when they act with reciprocity and consent.
These values are shared in every language, culture and country - and yet wars, coercion and violence remain.
intro2: A universal wording unites everyone who wants a life free of violence.
intro3: One wording that everyone agrees on lets people from different countries, nations and cultures trust one another, know that the value of life comes before everything for all of us, and reach mutual consent.

prayerTitle: A Prayer for Peace / Rabbi Nachman of Breslov
prayerBody:
Master of peace, Sovereign to whom peace belongs, who makes peace and creates all.
May it be Your will to abolish wars and bloodshed from the world, and to spread a great and wondrous peace over the earth,
so that nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
Help us and save us all, that we may always hold fast to the way of peace, and that there be a truly great peace between every person and their fellow, between husband and wife, and no dispute at all, even in the heart, among all people.
May everyone love peace and pursue peace always, in truth and with a whole heart; may we hold no grudge ever, not even against those who disagree with us,
and may we never shame any person in the world, from the least to the greatest, and truly fulfil the commandment "Love your neighbour as yourself" with all our heart, body, soul and means.
And may the verse be fulfilled in us: "I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down and none shall make you afraid; I will remove evil beasts from the land, and the sword shall not pass through your country."
The Eternal is peace; bless us with peace.
